item.title: ACMobility Suffers 1H 2026 Loss Despite BYD Sales Surge
item.description: ACMobility suffered a P 57 million net loss in the first half of 2026 compared to a P 34 million profit in the same period last year despite booming BYD sales. This was revealed in Ayala Corporation’s 1H 2026 financial report. Read More »
